subject: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@acme.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & POC planning

Hi Jordan / Aisha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before drafting a formal POC plan: 

Summary of needs (what I heard)
- Evaluate latency/cost for user-facing summary generation at 512 tokens
- Validate the KV cache integration for session continuity across requests
- Confirm compliance needs: audit logs + data retention settings

Success criteria (proposed)
1) Avg 95th-percentile inference latency under 300ms for 512-token responses under expected traffic (50 r/s burst)
2) Integration of KV cache with no user-state loss across 5-minute sessions
3) Logs/audit evidence available for all POC requests (retention 90 days)

Proposed POC timeline (high level)
- Kickoff: week of June 14 (1-hour tech + product alignment)
- Week 1: baseline tests and quick integration (auth + sample prompts)
- Weeks 2-3: workload testing, KV cache validation, cost monitoring
- Final readout: week of July 6 with results and recommended next steps

Owners
- Redwood technical lead: Dev Patel (cc'd)
- Redwood CS / success: Rachel Kim
- Acme product lead: Jordan Willis

Nice-to-have: security reviewer on kickoff to confirm audit & retention expectations (cc'ing acme-security is fine)

Attachments: I'll attach a one-page scope and a draft SOW after we confirm timeline.

Would you confirm the success criteria above and whether the proposed kickoff week (June 14) works for your team? Once confirmed, we'll send a calendar invite and a brief tech prep doc.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>, acme-security@acme.com
Date: 2026-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & POC planning

Thanks Marissa — that looks good and matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: 300ms P95 is our goal, but if you can show 250ms on the baseline that would give us headroom.
- KV cache: critical for our multi-turn flows — we'll provide sample session traces.
- Logs: Acme security will want evidence that logs are immutable and retention policies are enforced; I've looped them in.

Timeline: June 14 kickoff works for product and engineering. Can we aim for a 3-week active testing window and final readout on July 9 (Fri) to accommodate our exec calendar?

Also, who will need VPN/network access for the initial integration? Our infra team prefers to limit access to named engineers.

Jordan
Jordan Willis
Senior Product Manager | Acme Industries
jordan.willis@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@acme.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Great — thanks for the clarifications. Confirming updated timeline & owners below and attaching the one-page scope + draft SOW for review.

Confirmed success criteria
- P95 latency target: 250-300ms (goal 250ms, accept 300ms)
- KV cache verification across 5-minute sessions
- Immutable audit logs with 90-day retention and export capability

POC plan (detailed)
- Kickoff (60m) — week of June 14: introductions, network checklist, sample prompts, success criteria sign-off
- Week of June 15: Integration sprint — auth, sample prompts, initial bandwidth testing
- Week of June 22: KV cache validation + correctness tests (Dev-led)
- Week of June 29: Load and cost benchmarking (50 r/s burst scenarios)
- Week of July 6: Buffer week for fixes + final readout prep
- Final readout: Friday, July 9 — 45m exec recap with results and recommended next steps

Redwood owners & action items
- Dev Patel (technical lead): responsible for integration support, KV test harness, runbooks
- Rachel Kim (CS): weekly check-ins, success criteria tracking, exec readout prep
- Stephanie Nguyen (legal/ops): will shepherd SOW and any procurement questions

Action items for Acme
- Share sample session traces & a shortlist of prompt templates (Jordan)
- Confirm named engineers who will receive network access (Jordan / infra)
- Security: confirm minimal set of evidence required for logs immutability (acme-security)

Attachments included: redwood_poc_scope_v1.pdf, poc_sow_acme.docx

Next steps
- I'll send a calendar invite for kickoff (please indicate preferred days/times next week)
- Dev, can you confirm availability for the kickoff window (June 14-18) and whether you'd like any pre-kickoff auth artifacts?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Thanks Marissa — I'm available for kickoff on any day in the June 14-18 window except June 16.

A few technical notes / prep items:
- For initial integration we'll need a service account and an allowlist of IPs. If you prefer VPN, one named engineer's cert is fine.
- Please upload sample session traces to a shared S3 link or provide them in the kickoff packet.
- I'll prepare a KV cache verification harness (unit + smoke tests) and a baseline latency script.

I'll also create a short tech prep doc (auth + sample request formats) and share before the kickoff.

Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@acme.com>

Thanks everyone — we're all set on our side. Confirming:
- Kickoff: Tuesday, June 15 at 10:00 AM PT (60m) — please send invite
- Named engineers for network access: will send a secure list to Marissa by EOD Monday (6/14)
- Security: acme-security will prepare a short checklist for the kickoff (audit log format + retention confirmation)

We reviewed the attached scope and SOW and will sign once the kickoff confirms no major changes. I've also shared the DocuSign link to our procurement contact (linked below). Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Jordan
